1. Read the map
config/schema_map.py
Every table, source
and column expression

core/extractor.py
Source rows and
option set cache

core/transformer.py
core/expressions.py
COALESCE, CASE, LOOKUP,
OPTIONSET, FK resolution

name conventions

core/loader.py
